item.tib: tshe bsgrab g.yung drung 'khyil pa'i dbu bzhug gzhung
item.coloph: de ltar mi 'gyur g.yung drung gis (gi) tshe bsgrub (sgrab/)dgos 'dod ma lus 'byung byed dang / phyi rab (rabs) 'gro ba'i don ched du/ tshe dbang rig 'dzin chen po yi (yis/)man ngag kun gyi bcud phyung nas/ tshe sgrub g.yung drung 'khyil pa 'di/ 'gro ba tshe nyams don ched du/ khyung lung dngul mkhar gnas su mdzad/ skal ldan gcig rgyud 880ma rtogs pa'i (pas/)nga du ma spel snying la 'chang / las ldan bu la smin par mdzod/ a ya atham/ sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ gnas mchog phug leb stag rtse ru/ rnal 'byor mi bshig (shig) rdo rje rtsal la brgyud do//
